tree.heading: Administrative support
tree.text: The Secretary of the Interior shall provide all necessary administrative support to accomplish the requirements of sections 2002 and 2003 of this title.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly set out as a note under section 1681 of this title.
